name: Mindergy VR
summary:
Mindergy brings evidence-inspired mindfulness, breathing exercises, and relaxation into virtual reality, creating immersive experiences designed to help you reduce stress, improve focus, and restore mental balance.
Whether you need a quick reset during a busy workday, a calming evening routine, or simply a moment to disconnect from everyday pressures, Mindergy offers guided experiences that make relaxation feel natural and engaging.
